whatIsIt.eli5: Grades how well a turned box matches the real turned box.
whatIsIt.simple: Treats each rotated box as a soft blob (a Gaussian) and measures how much two blobs overlap. Works smoothly for any angle.
whatIsIt.engineer: Probabilistic IoU via Bhattacharyya distance between Gaussian representations of oriented boxes.

whyExists.eli5: Normal overlap is hard to measure for turned boxes.
whyExists.simple: Exact rotated IoU is not smooth; ProbIoU gives a clean learning signal.
whyExists.engineer: Differentiable, angle-continuous surrogate for rotated IoU.
